This repository produces `vis42.mcpb`, an MCP Bundle for Claude Desktop: a Node.js stdio-to-HTTP proxy forwarding MCP operations to `https://vis42.com/api/mcp`.

The proxy must answer Claude Desktop's `initialize` immediately, connect lazily on first request, and never block in startup. Transport **constructors never throw**. Errors surface only when `client.connect()` is awaited. The SSE fallback must wrap the `connect()` call.

All log output must go to `stderr`. `stdout` is the MCP protocol channel.

Tools are `{ name, description }` only; upstream runtime hints must not appear in the manifest. `readOnlyHint` and other hints are not valid manifest fields. `manifest.prompts[].arguments` must be `string[]` (string names, not objects). `resources` is **not a valid manifest field**; runtime uses existing `resources/list`, `resources/read`, and `resources/templates/list` handlers.
